_meta.name: BiRefNet background removal
_meta.notes: Native ComfyUI 0.41 nodes only — mirrors the official utility_birefnet_remove_background template. RemoveBackground emits a foreground mask (1 = subject); JoinImageWithAlpha treats mask 1 as transparent, so the mask is inverted first. Output is a single RGBA cutout PNG (alpha channel doubles as the matte).
